### PgTime(long)

Creates a time from microseconds since midnight, between zero and 86,400,000,000 inclusive.

```csharp
public PgTime(long microseconds)
```

Parameters:

`microseconds` — [long](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.int64)

The time of day in microseconds.

Exceptions:
